messages:
jeff: heads up - noticed weird canary behavior this morning, looks like some tenants are never hitting the canary even though their header matches the canary rule
marta: can you paste the route snippet? are we seeing header override + session stickiness interaction?
jeff: yep - here's the route block from the gateway config:
```json
{
  "match": { "header": { "X-Experiment": "beta" } },
  "split": [ { "weight": 10, "backend": "canary" }, { "weight": 90, "backend": "stable" } ],
  "session_affinity": { "type": "cookie", "cookie_name": "rw_sess" }
}
```
Only tenants with a fresh session get into the 10% slice; existing sticky cookies keep hitting stable even though header is present.

sahil: OK that matches the runtime logic - affinity is applied after split, so once cookie is set users stick. Header-based routing doesn't reset affinity by design.

anya: product ask: for experiments we want header to force-surface users into canary even if they have a cookie. Some QA workflows rely on header overrides.

marta: we need an exceptions model - either allow headers to bypass affinity when route has `experiment: true` or support a per-route `affinity_exceptions` list.

jeff: agreed. Also want telemetry to show how many requests were forced by header vs by normal sampling. Right now telemetry collapses them into the same bucket which hides bias.

eng-bot: perf note - any change to evaluation order could affect latency on hot path. microbenchmarks needed.

sahil: implementation options:
1) Add `override_affinity: true` on route - cheap change inside router check: if header matches and override_affinity, skip cookie lookup.
2) Add `affinity_exceptions: [{"type":"header","name":"X-Experiment"}]` - more generic but slightly more config parsing.
3) Keep current but add console toggle to reset cookie when header present (server-side set-cookie response) - ugly for existing sessions.

marta: prefer option 2 - generic and future-proof. Also add `telemetry.tags: ["forced_by_header"]` so we can split metrics.

anya: console UX needs a setting on rollout page: "Allow header overrides to bypass session affinity" with clear warning. Also a top-level metric showing % forced vs sample.

jeff: can we also add guardrail: only allow override for routes with `experiment_scope: tenant` or `global`? we don't want accidental tenant-wide forcing.

sahil: yes - will require validation in control plane and in the runtime policy. Runtime will check route metadata `allow_override_scopes` before skip-affinity.

marta: telemetry requirements:
- per-split counts by reason tag (sampled, forced_header, fallback)
- unique tenant cardinality for canary exposures
- latency/err rate by reason tag and by backend
- retention at least 7 days for quick rollbacks

jeff: also add an alert: if forced_header_exposure > 50% of canary traffic for > 10m, notify rollout owners. That detects mis-configured rollouts or QA scripts.

anya: can console show a small sample of request headers that triggered forced path? GDPR concerns but useful for debug - maybe only for admin users and scrub PII.

marta: implementation plan:
- sahil: add runtime flag and `affinity_exceptions` parsing (2 days)
- me: control plane validation + migration script to populate flag on existing routes (1 day)
- jeff: add telemetry tags and metrics (2 days)
- anya: UX copy + toggle on rollout page (1 day)
- ops: add alert and dashboard card (1 day)

deploy-bot: canary build queued: refs/heads/affinity-exceptions -> build 4821

sahil: I'll push a prototype PR with unit tests. Need help from infra for benchmark run to ensure latency delta < 0.5ms.

jeff: thanks. One more edge-case: what if header is set but malformed? prefer to treat as no-match (fail closed) and log once per minute per tenant.

marta: agreed. Add rate-limited logs and a telemetry counter for malformed override attempts.

anya: will update rollout docs and a short note for SRE playbooks.

jeff: cool. if no objections i'll merge the spec and we can triage follow-ups in a follow-up thread. :thumbsup:

marta: lgtm.

sahil: lgtm, I'll tag infra for perf run.

eng-bot: note: added issue #3248 to roadmap for UI toggle audit trail.
